facts.text: Owen, dinner is under control and so is the park. Stop looking at me like that and eat.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Claire's words, but she never says it. Her real lines on the quote page include 'We needed something scary and easy to pronounce.'
facts.fix: "We needed something scary and easy to pronounce."

fix_note.text: We needed something scary and easy to pronounce.

facts.text: Carried out of Margaritaville, two at once.
facts.why: The Margarita Man buys two margaritas and runs off holding both during the pterosaur attack on the park guests, so the line fits that moment.
facts.fix: Poured at the resort while the pterosaurs hit Main Street.

facts.text: Serve the snacks when the mosasaur leaps up to grab its lunch.
facts.why: The mosasaurus feeding show has the mosasaur leaping up to take its food, and it later drags the Indominus under. Fits.

vibe.verdict: Clean park-admission look and the right ride and feeding show, but the writing is plain for a film full of jokes and sponsors.
